desc: Ideation: f(x,y) = minimax = LCA weight in Kruskal reconstruction tree; assignment reduces to bottom-up greedy on that tree (O((N+M) log M)).

Implement the full solution in Python: Kruskal reconstruction tree (DSU building parent/children/weight arrays), bottom-up greedy aggregation of unmatched A/B counts per node (iterative post-order), accumulating matched × node_weight into a 64-bit answer, with fast stdin parsing and stdout output; mentally verify against both samples.

Verify the ultrametric/LCA property and greedy optimality (cut argument: each reconstruction-tree node forces ≥ |A_in − B_in| pairs across its cut at cost ≥ w_v; greedy achieves all bounds simultaneously); sanity-check on samples 1 and 2 by hand.
Check edge cases: K=1, star MST, equal edge weights (binary DSU merges fine), duplicate vertices in A/B (multiset counts), 64-bit answer magnitude (up to ~2×10¹⁴).
